- **Text (`#202923`)**: Deep forest charcoal providing sharp typographical hierarchy and 11:1+ contrast against light surfaces.

- **Border (`#e2e8e3`)**: Subtle structural boundaries separating canvas, utility sidebars, and grid elements.
- **Primary (`#176b50`)**: Deep pine green applied exclusively to actionable primitives: primary button fills, focus outlines, text link states, and selection cursors.

### Dark Mode
- **Canvas (`#101113`)**: Neutral charcoal foundation that avoids muddy gray tones.
- **Surface (`#191b1f`)**: Subtle lift for document cards, modals, and tool trays.
- **Subtle (`#23252a`)**: Deeper utility layer for segment controls and tool shelves.
- **Hover (`#2c2f34`)**: High-fidelity hover transition for interactive table rows and dropdown items.
- **Text (`#f0f1f3`)**: Crisp, cool off-white for zero-flicker editorial scanning.
- **Muted (`#a8adb5`)**: Secondary text color with strict WCAG AA adherence.
- **Border (`#32363d`)**: Razor-thin structural perimeter definition.
- **Primary Mint (`#9cd7b9`)**: Luminous mint accent for high-contrast dark accents, active states, and selection markers.
- **Primary Text (`#101113`)**: Charcoal ink fill used exclusively inside `#9cd7b9` primary button pills.

Under no circumstances should `#176b50` or any dark green value be used as a canvas fill, panel background, sidebar tint, or large banner fill. Green is an instrument of state, selection, and primary progression only.

8px control radii, 12px cards, 16px dialog corners, 44px touch targets, thin border #e2e8e3, Inter font. No marketing fluff, genuine customer productivity product.

## Brand & Style

This design system embodies the quiet, focused discipline of high-performance productivity tools. Built for document crafting, knowledge synthesis, and structured editing, it favors restraint over ornament and clarity over novelty. The visual character merges the considered ergonomics of Apple productivity software with the systematic structural utility of Google Workspace.

The primary aesthetic direction is modern minimalism built on crisp structural geometry, hairline containment, and expansive breathing room. The interface recedes entirely to elevate user content. It never competes for visual dominance; dark green is deployed strictly as an intentional focal point (primary text links, active selection badges, or primary action buttons), never as a wide background, container fill, or structural panel surface. Dark mode moves to a neutral charcoal slate with precise edge definitions, avoiding heavy chromatic tints to minimize cognitive fatigue during prolonged focus sessions.

## Colors

The palette operates with clinical precision across two distinct viewing contexts.

### Light Mode (Default)
- **Canvas (`#f7f8f7`)**: Foundation background offering low-glare reading comfort.
- **Surface (`#ffffff`)**: Pure white reserved for document pages, elevated inspector sheets, and active panels.
- **Subtle (`#f0f3f0`)**: Low-contrast background for utility toolbars, table headers, and secondary panel states.
- **Text (`#202923`)**: Deep forest charcoal providing sharp typographical hierarchy and 11:1+ contrast against light surfaces.
- **Muted (`#69736d`)**: Mid-tone for non-editable metadata, timestamps, keyboard shortcuts, and inactive icons.
- **Border (`#e2e8e3`)**: Subtle structural boundaries separating canvas, utility sidebars, and grid elements.
- **Primary (`#176b50`)**: Deep pine green applied exclusively to actionable primitives: primary button fills, focus outlines, text link states, and selection cursors.

### Dark Mode
- **Canvas (`#101113`)**: Neutral charcoal foundation that avoids muddy gray tones.
- **Surface (`#191b1f`)**: Subtle lift for document cards, modals, and tool trays.
- **Subtle (`#23252a`)**: Deeper utility layer for segment controls and tool shelves.
- **Hover (`#2c2f34`)**: High-fidelity hover transition for interactive table rows and dropdown items.
- **Text (`#f0f1f3`)**: Crisp, cool off-white for zero-flicker editorial scanning.
- **Muted (`#a8adb5`)**: Secondary text color with strict WCAG AA adherence.
- **Border (`#32363d`)**: Razor-thin structural perimeter definition.
- **Primary Mint (`#9cd7b9`)**: Luminous mint accent for high-contrast dark accents, active states, and selection markers.
- **Primary Text (`#101113`)**: Charcoal ink fill used exclusively inside `#9cd7b9` primary button pills.

### Rule of Application
Under no circumstances should `#176b50` or any dark green value be used as a canvas fill, panel background, sidebar tint, or large banner fill. Green is an instrument of state, selection, and primary progression only.

## Typography

Inter serves as the single typographic workhorse across all roles to ensure functional neutrality, crisp metric alignment, and exceptional legibility across dense data tables, toolbars, and rich text documents.

- **Editorial Scale**: Display (32px) and Headline (24px/20px) levels utilize tighter letter tracking (-0.01em to -0.02em) to eliminate awkward character gaps in document headers and workspace titles.
- **Reading Comfort**: Body text features proportional line heights (1.57x to 1.62x) specifically tuned to long-form reading, markdown composition, and document annotation.
- **Interface & Metrics**: UI labels, property inspectors, and status indicators strictly employ medium weights (500) to remain razor-sharp at compact sub-14px sizes. JetBrains Mono is designated for code blocks, token values, line metrics, and hotkey labels.

## Layout & Spacing

The workspace leverages a persistent, high-efficiency application frame:
- **Navigation Sidebar**: Fixed at exactly `224px` width. Collapsible into an icon-only or hidden rail.
- **Top Utility Bar**: Fixed at exactly `70px` height. Houses global search, presence chips, layout mode switches, and export actions.
- **Outer Canvas Margins**: Generous `32px` (`2rem`) padding framing the central document staging ground.
- **Document Viewport**: Max-width locked to `840px` for standard reading view, expanding to 100% fluid grid when entering data-dense table or canvas modes.
- **Touch & Click Standard**: All interactive triggers conform to a minimum interactive target size of `44px` (visually centered within compact bounding boxes where necessary).
- **Responsive Breakpoints**:
  - `Desktop (> 1280px)`: Full 224px sidebar, active document staging, right-side contextual inspector (280px).
  - `Tablet (768px - 1279px)`: Sidebar collapses to 56px icon rail; right inspector becomes an overlay sheet; top bar retains 70px height.
  - `Mobile (< 768px)`: Navigation and toolbars tuck into floating bottom bars and top utility dropdowns; canvas margins drop to 16px.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system rejects heavy skeumorphic drops, harsh cast shadows, and blurry glassmorphism in favor of low-contrast outlines and razor-thin tonal layers.

- **Level 0 (Base Canvas)**: Flat `#f7f8f7` (light) or `#101113` (dark). No shadow.
- **Level 1 (Panels & Sidebar)**: Single-pixel structural border (`#e2e8e3` light / `#32363d` dark) separating the canvas from the 224px sidebar and 70px topbar. No shadow.
- **Level 2 (Document Sheet & Floating Cards)**: Surface color with a hairline border (`1px solid var(--border)`) reinforced by a micro ambient diffusion: `0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)`. In dark mode, light bleed is fully suppressed: `0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)`.
- **Level 3 (Modals, Command Palettes, Popovers)**: Maximum elevation. Bordered by `#e2e8e3` / `#32363d`, with ambient floor shadow: `0 12px 32px -4px rgba(16, 17, 19, 0.08), 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(16, 17, 19, 0.04)` (light) and `0 16px 40px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)` (dark). Modals overlay an ultra-subtle backdrop tint (`rgba(16, 17, 19, 0.3)` in light mode, `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)` in dark mode).

## Shapes

The geometric framework is calibrated to distinct functional scales:
- **Interactive Controls (Inputs, Buttons, Segment Toggles)**: `8px` corner radius. Crisp, clean, and modern without ballooning into excessive bubbles.
- **Content Cards & Inline Containers**: `12px` corner radius. Provides visual separation between the canvas and nested blocks.
- **Modals & Overlays**: `16px` corner radius. Softens larger floating surfaces against the structural workspace frame.
- **Badges & Avatars**: Full pill radius (`9999px`) for contextual tagging and team presence rings.

## Components

### Buttons & Interactive Controls
- **Target Height**: Desktop buttons align to 36px/40px height with strict 44px minimum target bounding envelopes.
- **Primary Button**: Light mode: solid `#176b50` fill with `#ffffff` text, 8px radius. Dark mode: solid `#9cd7b9` fill with `#101113` text. Zero shadow, no gradient.
- **Secondary Button**: Surface fill with a 1px border (`#e2e8e3` / `#32363d`). Text color is `#202923` (light) / `#f0f1f3` (dark). Hover transitions to Subtle (`#f0f3f0` / `#2c2f34`).
- **Ghost/Icon Button**: Transparent background, 8px radius. Transitions to `#f0f3f0` (light) or `#2c2f34` (dark) on hover. Accompanied by thin, purposeful stroke icons (1.5px stroke weight).

### Inputs & Field Controls
- **Inputs**: Height 36px, radius 8px. Surface fill, 1px border (`#e2e8e3` / `#32363d`).
- **Focus State**: Hairline transition to `1px solid #176b50` (light) or `1px solid #9cd7b9` (dark) with a 2px outer ambient glow at 15% opacity. Never thick or jarring.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px boxes/circles, 1px border. Checked state fills with `#176b50` (white tick) in light mode, or `#9cd7b9` (`#101113` tick) in dark mode.

### Document Cards & Content Blocks
- **Card Styling**: 12px radius, surface fill, 1px border (`#e2e8e3` / `#32363d`), padding 24px (`space-lg`).
- **Hover Interaction**: Outline shifts subtly to `#69736d` (light) or `#a8adb5` (dark) with no movement or scale change.

### Chips & Metadata Tags
- **Styling**: Height 24px, 8px or pill radius, subtle background fill (`#f0f3f0` / `#23252a`), label-sm typography (11px, 500 weight), text `#69736d` (light) / `#a8adb5` (dark).

### Modals & Dialogs
- **Styling**: 16px radius, max width 600px, 32px interior margin padding. Surrounded by Level 3 ambient shadow and a crisp 1px border.

### Command Palette & Quick Search
- **Styling**: Centered top-third modal (width 640px, radius 16px). Built with search input directly integrated without separation lines, followed by itemized result rows with hover fill (`#f0f3f0` / `#2c2f34`), 8px inner child radius, and trailing JetBrains Mono hotkey badges.

I have designed the paired **Light** and **Dark** screens for **Workflow 8: Optional Office Editing in Maqbool, Immutable Save, Stale Conflicts, and External Fallback**.

### Design Implementation Overview

1. **Maqbool · Document editing Light (`Maqbool · Document editing Light`)**:
   - **Shell & Navigation**: Consistent 224px sidebar with Maqbool wordmark and multicolour triangular bar logo, 70px topbar anchored to `Studio North / Projects / Harbour renewal (HR-2024)`, and `Files` active tab.
   - **Document Editing Workspace**: Shows the active document workspace for `Design summary.docx · v2` with clear metadata (Reference `HR-DOC-082`, `14.2 MiB`, `Source document`).
   - **Bridge Check & Verification**: Banner displaying `"Ready to save · Updated document received"` and verified payload size (`14.8 MiB`, strictly below the `25 MiB` per-file cap).
   - **Integrated ONLYOFFICE Document Canvas**: Authentic toolbar ribbon (`File`, `Home`, `Insert`, `Layout`, `References`, `Collaboration`, `View`) with Inter typography controls, formatting utilities, and a realistic architectural technical report (`Harbour Renewal - Phase 2 Design Summary`).
   - **Version Management & Immutable Save**: Side panel with explicit `"Save as version 3"` (`v3.0`), reassuring copy that *"Earlier reviews and delivery approvals still use their original versions"*, and the immediate next step: *"Next action: Open task and submit new version for review."*
   - **External Work Route**: Includes the exact prescribed fallback: *"Work on your computer - After editing on your computer, upload the updated file. Changes do not sync automatically."* with actions to Download and Add new version.

2. **Maqbool · Document editing Dark (`Maqbool · Document editing Dark`)**:
   - **Exact Dark Palette**: Built with pure neutral dark tokens (`#101113` canvas, `#191b1f` surface, `#23252a` subtle, `#32363d` border, `#9cd7b9` mint accent for primary actions, `#101113` text on primary). Absolutely no dark green panels, nav bars, or background washes.
   - **Stale Edit Conflict Modal**: Clean centered overlay displaying `"A newer version is already saved"` when another team member (Sam Lee) saved changes while editing was underway.
   - **Side-by-Side Version Preservation**: Compares the user's local buffer (`from v2`, `14.8 MiB`, Alex Morgan) with the current active file (`v3 active`, `15.1 MiB`, pinned to Milestone 2).
   - **Safe Conflict Actions**: Clear non-destructive options: `"Download my edited copy"`, `"Save as a separate file"`, and primary `"Open current version (v3)"` - eliminating any chance of silent overwrites or endless background loops.
   - **Offline Companion State**: Displays `"We can't reach your editing Mac"` with direct actions for `Retry connection` and `Work on your computer`.
   - **Permissions & Security Guardrails**: Clear notice for read-only viewers (*"You can preview this file. Editing is available to people assigned to this work or a project manager"*), maximum edited output size badge (`25 MiB`), and reminder that earlier pinned versions remain immutable.
